The same Chinese pairs 平章政事 with Zhang Rulin and 參知政事 with Liu Wei; the literal’s shared “Grand Councilors” is inaccurate, and the proposed office titles restore the source distinction without other changes.

故事皆不讀 means by precedent there was no reading, so “not read in full” wrongly softens 皆不讀; but 轉讀畢 still means the reading-aloud stage finished, and the proposal’s “that step” erases 轉讀.
